summary: R304 and R305 continue the narrow Paper 15 source-layout/source-style chain after R303. R304 applies two printed-p.142 repairs on top of R303: it restores the source comma/semicolon punctuation in Satz IV's basis list and moves the source footnote marker for formula (3) into the displayed formula after the parenthetical `(identisch in a,s_ik)`. R305 then applies a Paper 15-only source-style `\varrho` repair on top of R304, replacing 49 straight `\rho` tokens in representative source-confirmed Paper 15 loci with `\varrho`. The R305 cumulative German TeX/PDF builds with XeLaTeX and remains 474 pages.
global_caveat: Targeted Paper 15 support only. Source pages are 650dpi renders from GDZ material whose native quality is about 400ppi; enlarged crops are readability aids only. These packets are not Paper 15 certification, Noether closure, multilingual synchronization, whole-corpus source closure, or critical-edition material.
